Amount.description: Token amount in minor units of `mint`.

amount.description: Token amount in minor units of `mint`.

mint.description: SPL mint address (e.g. USDC). Free-form here; enforced at quote time.

ChannelParams.description: MPP session channel parameters the quote commits to.

grace_seconds.description: Buyer-exit grace window, seconds. Default 172800 (48h) per PLAN.md M2.

idle_timeout_seconds.description:
Idle window after which the studio settles at watermark and closes.
No default on purpose: the quote must commit to it explicitly.

GatePolicy.description: A project's procedural law (PLAN.md §2.1): state-machine edge → ordered hard gates. Negotiated in the Quote, hash-committed at FUNDED, tamper-evident thereafter. Semantics enforced by the engine, not expressible here: fail-closed evaluation, denial-with-note as recorded history, loud audited overrides. The implementation is additionally stricter than this schema: self-loop edge keys are rejected, agent lists must be duplicate-free, and k must not exceed the number of named agents.

edges.description:
Edge key `FROM->TO` (or wildcard `any->TO`) → ordered gates. A
concrete edge is guarded by its exact entry followed by any matching
wildcard entry — both apply.

GatePolicy.title: Gate policy

GateSpec.description: One gate on a state-machine edge (internally tagged on `type`).

oneOf.description:
A named principal must approve. Primary mechanism: native Buzz
workflow approval tokens; fallback: signed channel message with fixed
grammar. The principal is an opaque label (npub or a role like
`buyer`) — evidence must carry the same label.

escalate_after_seconds.description:
Blocked longer than this (from edge eligibility) → escalate to
the gate's principal, then the studio owner. Never auto-passes.

principal.description:
Opaque principal label — an npub or a role like `buyer`.
Evidence must carry the same label.

oneOf.description: k-of-n signed sign-offs from named crew agents.

A named verifiable predicate (CI green, endpoint answers its 402
challenge, schema validation passes). Reruns are natural, so the
latest result wins; a stale pass is expired evidence and blocks.
`PayPort` status: operator record in stub mode, tx signature live.
Minimum elapsed review window since the edge became eligible.

MilestoneSpec.description: One milestone: a demoable, acceptable, priced unit of work.

PayoutDestination.description:
Where settled funds go. v0: direct channel splits, exactly DESIGN.md
§4.3(a) — escrow pays the crew, no studio custody. The `vault` variant
(v1, ARCHITECTURE.md §2.3) will slot in beside `splits`.

Split.description:
One recipient's share, in basis points. Splits must sum to exactly
10_000 bps — every lamport of a settlement is accounted for.

recipient.description:
Solana address. Free-form here, like `Amount::mint`; enforced when
the live PayPort builds real session terms (M5).

description: The studio's priced answer to an RFQ (PLAN.md M2, DESIGN.md §3). Wire shape of POST /api/v1/rfqs/{id}/quote; the studio assigns id, created_at, status, and policy_hash. The implementation is additionally stricter than this schema: milestone amounts must sum to price.amount (milestone granularity is the dispute system), split bps must sum to exactly 10000, expires_at must be in the future at issue time, and the gate policy's structural rules (see gate-policy.json) are enforced.

engagement_endpoint.description:
The 402-gated URL acceptance opens the MPP session against (jude's
capability-request draft-00 §4): deposit = price, terms from `channel`,
payee = `payout_destination`.

expires_at.description: Past this instant the quote is LAPSED and cannot be accepted.

gate_policy.description: Defaults from studio config; buyers may strengthen per-project.

price.description: Total engagement price. Must equal the sum of milestone amounts.

timeline.description: Human-negotiated schedule description (e.g. "3 weeks, weekly demos").
